sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 288 (all 314 campsites parsed, loops A-E and the three T loops)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today. Book only through ReserveAmerica, not third-party sites. The camper must be 21 or older to reserve and occupy a site. Check in by 9 pm Mon-Wed, 10 pm Thu, 11:30 pm Fri-Sat or risk losing the reservation. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. One trailer/RV/motorhome and 6 people per trailer site; no tents in the T (trailer) loops. A second car parks outside the campground with a one-time pass fee. Cottages need 7 nights in core season, 3 in peak, 2 off-peak.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wildwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=288 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; GENERAL INFORMATION; LENGTH OF STAY; Cottages minimums), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The 76 sites in the three T (trailer) loops are full hookup with 30 A electric; loops A-E (238 sites) have no hookups.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 288 (Main Area / North Overlook / South Overlook T Loop: 'Electric Hookup available: 30 amp', 'Full Hookup available' on all 76; 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no' on the other 238), read 2026-10-21

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 314 campsites: the T loops' 76 full-hookup sites are all 50-ft pull-throughs (Main Area 42, South Overlook 18, North Overlook 16); loops A-E have 37 sites at 30 ft, 80 at 20 ft and 121 with no length listed (including tent platforms). Also 10 cottages.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wildwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=288 ('Campsite (314)', 'Cottage (10)') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 288 (T loops '50 Pull-Through' 76; loops A-E '30 Back-In'/'30' 37, '20 Back-In' 80, no length 121), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campfires only in above-ground metal containers (bring one or rent at the Camp Store).

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/wildwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=288 ('Water for drinking and washing dishes is located throughout the camp'; 'may be rented from the park concessionaire at the Camp Store'; 'dumping stations are nearby'; '... and showers'; Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Restroom, Showers, Water Fillup Station, Convenience Store), read 2026-10-21

summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season (T, B, D Apr 16; A, C, E May 28; to Oct 10; unchanged), reservable (booking was only inherited; now verified). Added 9-month window, 14-night max (no campsite minimum stated), 21+ registration, full hookups 30 A on the 76 T-loop sites (50-ft pull-throughs), 314 sites, showers, dump, water, camp store. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept unchanged.
